description: Tuning set: the Day 1 failed questions (HisabDO/phase1-review/PHASE1_RESULTS_ANALYSIS_AND_CODE_REVIEW.md, section 3, 2026-10-22). Retrieval thresholds, top-k and the query-rewrite glossary are tuned on this set only.

expect_values.answer: the approved KB answers it: at least one fully relevant passage must reach the context, and no unrelated passage may
expect_values.none: not a knowledge question (own figures, someone else's account, a correction): the context must be empty
expect_values.no_answer_in_kb: a knowledge question the approved sources do not answer: no unrelated passage may reach the context (empty is correct)

excluded.question: (any message of 100,000 characters)
excluded.reason: API-limit issue, not retrieval. Checked separately as a robustness case: the normaliser truncates the query and retrieval must not fail.
